Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Pre-deploy check** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions and was unhealthy (18% error rate). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so per policy I requested approval.
2. **Approval** — change-manager approved deploying v2.3.2.
3. **Deploy** — v2.3.2 rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-deploy verification: healthy=true, error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Incident** — the first attempt to create the SEV3 incident timed out; I verified via `list_incidents` that nothing was created, then retried successfully. Incident **INC-0001** is open, recording the hotfix deployment and the v2.3.1 health issue (on-call was paged).
